Method of Attack: Botnet malware used to infect users and download other malware, offering install space for other crooks; Renting out botnet to other cybercriminals; Configured to avoid infecting users in Belarus and CIS countries
Discoverer: Belarusian police as part of joint FBI and Europol investigation; Microsoft, ESET, Shadowserver Foundation, ICANN, and other organizations; Recorded Future (threat intel firm); FBI (undercover agent Dzhigurda)
Attack Vector: Selling and promoting malware on hacking forums; Selling source code to undercover FBI agent; Malware infection leading to botnet formation
Indicators of Compromise: Andromeda botnet sinkholed by Microsoft, ESET, Shadowserver Foundation, ICANN
